lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows, extending posteriorly from the gill region along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming distinct high-contrast grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a high-luminance upper margin and a shadowed ventral margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, low-contrast, high-luminance spots is visible, primarily localized on the posterior half of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, irregular indentation or notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region and the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibit a significantly higher spatial frequency and density of smaller, high-intensity blobs compared to the primary lateral flank.
